# Shared Glossary And Knowledge Loading

- Read `CONTEXT.md` before naming repo concepts, roles, gates, artifacts, or source-of-truth boundaries when vocabulary matters.
- Do not treat `CONTEXT.md` as a knowledge index.
- Read `docs/agents/knowledge/README.md` before loading repository knowledge files.
- Load only files whose `When to read` triggers match the current task.
- Record selected knowledge files, skipped related candidates, and rationale in planning or testing artifacts when the role creates them.
